detail.longDescription: Why train a forecasting model on one-step-ahead errors when you care about 10-step-ahead accuracy? This is the core motivation behind multistep losses in dynamic models. This has connection with the so-called “direct forecasting strategy”. And here what it is and how to work with it in Python: https:// openforecast.org/2026/08/31/sm ooth-in-python-multistep-losses/ # forecasting # datascience # machinelearning
